data.body:
IMPLEMENTED — Gerrit change 2344 (45dba2bb841b), pushed for review, NOT submitted.

SEQUENCING CHECK (mandatory precondition). injurious-pugnacious-azurevase (c0f6-0fc9-fe48-41bc) — the sibling that also declares scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py in its file impact — has LANDED on origin/main as 1049da8f61b8 ("Fix config root in composer save-time advisories"). Its guard extension (the str()-wrapped store argument) and its _store/sync.py sanctions are already merged; the ticket is merely not yet closed. So there was no concurrent editor of the guard and no sequencing conflict. This change edits only the guard's DOCSTRING (draining the run_sweep sanction from the "sanctioned sites today" list), which does not touch the detection logic c0f6 added. Note c0f6 also split the realpath()/abspath() family out to flowered-basaltic-beagle (088b-e4c1-050c-4516) — disjoint from this site, which is the bare dirname(tracker) form.

THE STALE BLOCKER, CORRECTED. This ticket's description and its RCA both concluded that a correct code root needed a spawn-contract change, on the premise that "there is no existing helper returning the right durable code root for BOTH topologies". That premise is false, and the description has been corrected so the next reader is not misled:
  * Deployment: REBAR_ROOT is exported UNCONDITIONALLY (infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:102 ENV; infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:294 documents that it is deliberately outside the PAT guard), so repo_root_or_none()'s second precedence arm resolves the code root directly.
  * Local worktree: _proc.detached_child_cwd (src/rebar/_proc.py:127-150) ALREADY anchors the detached child's cwd at dirname(realpath(tracker)) — the durable main checkout, with realpath load-bearing precisely to escape the ephemeral worktree's .tickets-tracker symlink (bugs 3198/93a9). So the git-toplevel arm lands on the durable code root, preserving today's correct local behaviour.
The RCA's own worry — "naively threading maybe_compact's repo_root would point the outliving child at a dying worktree" — is an argument AGAINST the spawn-contract design, not against resolution. The rejected alternative is recorded in the commit message: threading the root reimplements repo_root_or_none() at the spawn site, where the parent's root is the dying worktree.

THE FIX. One line in the child: `repo_root = config.repo_root_or_none()` at compact_trigger.py run_sweep, replacing `os.path.dirname(tracker)`; the `# repo-root-ok:` sanction is removed. snapshot_repo_root() was NOT used — its snapshot-specific "." fallback (_config_resolvers.py:444-462) is the fatherly-incoherent-mare outage shape and run_sweep does not want it. A stale comment at the _spawn_detached_sweep call site, which justified handing over the canonical tracker partly because "inside run_sweep this argument also becomes repo_root = dirname(tracker)", was corrected too — the canonical-tracker rationale stands on the cwd-durability ground alone.

TESTS (RED-first, mutation-checked). tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py gains three: the sweep folds per the repo's non-default [compact] block on a relocated store; the root handed to compact_all_cli IS the resolved code root (pinned at the seam); and a repo config that folds nothing still folds nothing. Config comes from a rebar.toml FILE, never REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD / REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS, because an env read is root-independent and would hide the bug. tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py gains the AC#3 assertion that no config-root site is deferred behind a sanction.

Note on the contrast control: the first draft pivoted it on the threshold and was WRONG — select_tickets' BACKFILL arm selects any snapshot-less ticket with at least one foldable event whatever the threshold, so it folded anyway. The real discriminator is the HORIZON (the default 1800 s puts just-written events out of reach, which is exactly why the buggy root folded nothing). Rewritten to pivot on the horizon and documented in the test.

MUTATION RESULTS — 3 mutants, 3 killed.
  M1 re-seed the exact defect, dirname(tracker): BOTH behaviour tests fail. Killed.
  M2 drop the resolver and hand repo_root=None (let compose_config discover downstream): the FOLD test still PASSES — the outcome is accidentally right in-test — and only the seam assertion catches it. Killed by the seam test alone. This is the "a different guard rescues it" trap; without the seam test the mutant survives.
  M3 dirname(realpath(tracker)), the plausible near-miss: both fail. Killed.
Restored: green.

GATES (all local, worktree venv; no MCP agentic op): make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (683 files); pytest tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py 4 passed; scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check new=0 increased=0; scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py rc=0 with zero deferred config-root sites; the three touched unit modules 50 passed.

NOT CLOSED: change 2344 awaits LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
